title: Version-consistent daily and seven-day market dynamics
objective: Add display-only day-over-day change and seven-day relative water-level derivations to the daily CardKit brief using only complete, version-consistent persisted observations, with explicit insufficient-history states.
owner_authorization: Owner authorized daily aggregate reporting. This task reads existing local aggregate history only; it does not add Dune queries, new external providers, backfills, or CardKit sends before independent audit GREEN.
forbidden_actions: Do not add or execute Dune queries, external providers, migrations, backfills, or CardKit sends before independent audit GREEN.
Do not compare values across query_version, registry_version, coverage status, subject, or completeness boundaries.
Do not infer a missing prior day as zero, display a 7D baseline with fewer than seven complete prior UTC days, or build a cross-chain score/recommendation.
Do not add buying, selling, buyer, graduation, full Robinhood, Four.meme, FDV/market-cap, TVL, smart money, Kline, chain adapter, signing, or trading claims.
